grammar.purpose: Direct an action toward a recipient
grammar.explanation: 向当地朋友请教 identifies the person approached for advice, not a physical compass direction. 向大家介绍 directs an explanation to an audience. This unit contrasts the action recipient with 朝门口走 from the previous unit. Asking one person does not make their answer representative of everyone.

examples.py: xiàng dāng dì péng you qǐng jiào .
examples.en: Ask a local friend for advice.

examples.zh: 她向大家介绍自己的习惯。
examples.py: tā xiàng dà jiā jiè shào zì jǐ de xí guàn .
examples.en: She introduces her own custom to everyone.

examples.py: xiàng zhǔ rén wèn qīng chǔ shí jiān .
examples.en: Ask the host to clarify the time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 向朋友请教，所以所有人都这样做。
commonMistakes.right: 向朋友请教，再说明这是她的习惯。
commonMistakes.why: The recipient is an informant, not proof of universal practice.

grammar.purpose: Compare a stated feature without equating every feature
grammar.explanation: 像平时一样先问时间 compares the specific procedure of asking the time. 像朋友一样交流 compares a manner of interaction; it does not literally establish friendship. State the feature being compared. Avoid an analogy that turns a performance, ancient story or one host’s practice into a universal custom.

examples.py: xiàng píng shí yī yàng , xiān wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: As usual, ask the time first.

examples.py: dà jiā xiàng péng you yī yàng jiāo liú .

examples.zh: 这次的安排像上次一样。
examples.py: zhè cì de ān pái xiàng shàng cì yī yàng .
examples.en: This time’s arrangement is like last time’s.

commonMistakes.wrong: 像朋友一样交流，就是所有人已经是朋友。
commonMistakes.right: 像朋友一样交流，是比较交流方式。
commonMistakes.why: A comparison of manner does not establish actual identity.

dialogue.title: Ask the host, not the whole world
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 做客要带什么？网上说每个人都一样。
lines.py: zuò kè yào dài shén me ? wǎng shàng shuō měi gè rén dōu yī yàng .
lines.en: What should I bring as a guest? Online it says everyone is the same.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先向主人问。这次是她家的安排。
lines.py: xiān xiàng zhǔ rén wèn . zhè cì shì tā jiā de ān pái .
lines.en: Ask the host first. This is her household’s arrangement.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她说像平时一样，先问时间就好。
lines.py: tā shuō xiàng píng shí yī yàng , xiān wèn shí jiān jiù hǎo .
lines.en: She says as usual, just ask the time first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那不用把电影里的场景当规则了。
lines.py: nà bù yòng bǎ diàn yǐng lǐ de chǎng jǐng dāng guī zé le .
lines.en: Then I need not treat a film scene as a rule.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对。古代、现代和当地习惯，也不能混在一起。
lines.py: duì . gǔ dài , xiàn dài hé dāng dì xí guàn , yě bù néng hùn zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: Right. Ancient, modern and local practices should not be mixed together.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我向朋友请教，再向大家介绍她的习惯。
lines.py: wǒ xiàng péng you qǐng jiào , zài xiàng dà jiā jiè shào tā de xí guàn .
lines.en: I will ask my friend and introduce her practice to everyone.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 说清楚是她的习惯，不是所有人的。
lines.py: shuō qīng chǔ shì tā de xí guàn , bù shì suǒ yǒu rén de .
lines.en: Clarify that it is hers, not everyone’s.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。不知道就问，比假装都知道自然。
lines.py: hǎo . bù zhī dào jiù wèn , bǐ jiǎ zhuāng dōu zhī dào zì rán .
lines.en: Okay. Asking when unsure is more natural than pretending to know everything.
lines.speaker: b
